mission.statement: Improve learning engagement and mental health through gamification, helping every student discover their identity and potential.
mission.tagline: Make learning feel like play. Make growth feel like winning.
mission.philosophy: Focus on the need for improved mental health and engagement. Highlight the poor state of these in society and the need for technology and science used properly.

primaryPillars.name: Improve Engagement
primaryPillars.description: Make learning fun and addictive through gamification, turning education into an experience students want to return to
successIndicators: Students voluntarily use the app outside of assignments
Session times increase over first 30 days
Users return daily without external prompting

primaryPillars.name: Advance Mental Health
primaryPillars.description: Combat the youth mental health crisis through positive reinforcement, building resilience, and fostering a sense of accomplishment
successIndicators: Users set and achieve personal goals

crisis.girlsDepression: 145% increase in major depressive episodes since 2010
crisis.suicidalBehavior: 40%+ increase in suicidal behaviors among youth
crisis.screenTimeCorrelation: Social media linked to increased anxiety and depression

context.intervention: Technology can be part of the solution when designed with intention

primaryPillars.name: Enhance Academic Performance
primaryPillars.description: Improve learning outcomes through increased motivation, better study habits, and sustained engagement with educational content
successIndicators: Students study more frequently in shorter sessions

primaryPillars.name: Instill Growth Mindset
primaryPillars.description: Build identity around continuous improvement, helping students see challenges as opportunities and effort as the path to mastery
successIndicators: Users actively track and celebrate progress

coreThemes.name: Continuous Improvement
coreThemes.description: Always getting better - every day, every session, every interaction

coreThemes.name: Innovation
coreThemes.description: Novel solutions to old problems - rethinking education through modern technology

coreThemes.name: Competition & Achievement
coreThemes.description: The drive to succeed - channeling competitive energy into positive outcomes

coreThemes.name: Healing & Recovery
coreThemes.description: Mental health restoration - helping students recover from disengagement and disconnection

coreThemes.name: Safety & Identity
coreThemes.description: Building a secure sense of self - creating safe spaces for growth and self-discovery

identity.name: Identity Formation
identity.description: Help students discover who they are and who they can become

healing.name: Mental Health Healing
healing.description: Address the youth mental health crisis through positive technology

statistics.screenTimeCorrelation: Passive social media use linked to depression

connection.name: Human Connection
connection.description: Reconnect parents, teachers, and students through shared goals and visible progress
focuses: Teacher empowerment to manage and motivate

primary.name: Parents
primary.description: Parents seeking to support their children's education

guidingPrinciples.name: Self-Paced Learning
guidingPrinciples.description: Every student learns at their own speed - no shame in taking time, no ceiling on advancement
guidingPrinciples.implementation: Progress systems that reward individual growth, not comparison

guidingPrinciples.name: Universal Accessibility
guidingPrinciples.description: Free or low-cost for all - no student should be excluded due to economic circumstances
guidingPrinciples.implementation: Freemium model, school subsidies, no paywall on core features

guidingPrinciples.name: Identity-Focused
guidingPrinciples.description: Help students discover who they are and build confidence in who they can become
guidingPrinciples.implementation: Customization, achievement systems, personal branding within app

guidingPrinciples.name: Positive Reinforcement
guidingPrinciples.description: Rewards over punishment - build up rather than tear down
guidingPrinciples.implementation: Achievement celebrations, streak rewards, comeback mechanics

guidingPrinciples.name: Gamification
guidingPrinciples.description: Make learning feel like play - leverage game psychology for education
guidingPrinciples.implementation: XP, levels, achievements, quests, rewards, competition

guidingPrinciples.name: Student Agency
guidingPrinciples.description: Give students control and autonomy over their learning journey
guidingPrinciples.implementation: Choice in goals, customization, self-directed progress

fearFrustration: Schools are losing control of classrooms
Mental health crisis needs urgent action
Technology is making things worse - but it doesn't have to
hopePotential: Students deserve to feel worthy of successful lives
Every child can develop a growth mindset
Technology can be part of the solution
Engagement and mental health CAN improve together
valuePropositions: Connect parents to their children's progress

metadata.purpose: Single source of truth for all mission goals and strategic direction
